evals.name: default-scope-asks
evals.expected_output: Phase 0 asks the scope with capability:ask-user, then resolves and validates the harness root, records AS_OF_MS, runs project_root.py and creates a per-run CACHE_DIR with five scratch-<NAME> directories. It then creates a REPORT_DIR of its own, .harness/check-reports/check-harness-<YYYY-MM-DD>-<HHMMSS>-<scope>-<runtime>/ (runtime claude-code or agy, a -2 suffix when the name is taken), and Phase 3 writes report.md and report.html only there. Phase 1 spawns the matching analyzers in one message (5 for Both: PORTFOLIO, SESSION_USER, SESSION_PROJECT, CONTEXT, AUTOMATION), each prompt carrying harness_root=, cache_dir=, days=30 and report=<NAME>. check-harness saves each return to {CACHE_DIR}/<NAME>.json, scores 26 items over 6 axes, and writes report.md and report.html under .harness/check-reports/.

evals.name: overall-scope-explicit
evals.prompt: /check-harness overall — check my full Claude Code setup. I want to see which skills are dead and how I'm using agents.
evals.expected_output: User scope only: spawns skill-portfolio-analyzer (PORTFOLIO) and session-pattern-analyzer with scope=overall (SESSION_USER) in one message; no CONTEXT, AUTOMATION or SESSION_PROJECT spawn. Dead skills come from PORTFOLIO.summary.dead_count / skills[].dead in scratch-PORTFOLIO/inventory.json (renamed history and built-ins such as /loop are not ghosts), and agent use from SESSION_USER metrics (delegation_ratio, parallel_count = messages with >= 2 Agent spawns) over the last 30 days. B2 is judged from plan_first_ratio only, with no error for the missing artifact fallback.

evals.name: natural-language-trigger
evals.prompt: What's missing in the harness? Run a full project diagnosis.
evals.expected_output: Triggers check-harness with project or all scope. Runs project_root.py to find the project root (never $HOME), spawns SESSION_PROJECT (scope=project, project_dir=PROJECT_ROOT), context-quality-reviewer (CONTEXT) and project-automation-auditor (AUTOMATION); the report covers CLAUDE.md/rules quality, hooks from every source (project, user, plugin), the Axis 5 items D1–D6, and the Phase 2 joins for D4, D5 and E2.

evals.name: agy-empty-subagent-registry
evals.prompt: /check-harness all (running under Antigravity; manage_subagents returns an empty registry, every analyzer returns a valid report)
evals.expected_output: The run does not halt. The Delegation assertion reads manage_subagents once, records each analyzer's evidence grade as 'spawn return only (agy registry empty)', and continues to Phase 2. The report footer (markdown and the HTML {{DELEGATION_EVIDENCE}} slot) states that grade per analyzer, alongside the 30-day period and CACHE_DIR.

evals.name: missing-analyzer-return
evals.prompt: /check-harness all (the context-quality-reviewer spawn returns nothing usable — prose with no JSON object)
evals.expected_output: The run halts before Phase 2 with 'failed: spawn-named-checker returned no usable result (context-quality-reviewer CONTEXT: <reason>)', naming the analyzer and report, and prints no score. A report file that exists on disk does not substitute for the missing return.

evals.name: html-report-fully-rendered
evals.prompt: /check-harness all — and open the HTML report
evals.expected_output: report.html is written from references/html-template.html with every placeholder replaced — the file contains no literal '{{'. Empty lists render as a single 'None' item. The footer reads '26 items · 6 axes · session <id> · last 30 days · cache <CACHE_DIR> · evidence <per-analyzer grades>'. The file is opened with capability:run-command.

evals.name: new-artifacts-lessons-ledgers-autopilot
evals.prompt: /check-harness project (the project has a loop.md with a real '## Lessons' record committed this week, including a '- form: gate1-command' lesson, a build_order.md, and an autopilot.md from a real run — its '## State' has run_started_at: 2026-10-30T01:00Z — whose '## Config' still sets killswitch_path: <runDir>/STOP)
evals.expected_output: AUTOMATION's project_signals.json reports lessons.updated_30d true and lessons.hardened_added_90d >= 1, so E1 and E3 can pass on lessons; ledgers lists build_order 1 and autopilot 1 in the Compounding Detail. D6 'Unattended runs are bounded' is FAIL, naming the autopilot.md path and killswitch_path in missing_limits (a <…> value is a placeholder). Skill stubs and templates (.claude/skills/, skills/, references/, tests/) are never counted as ledgers; with no real autopilot.md, D6 would be N/A.
